text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The victor was T.M. Opera O. Though she 
put on a run befitting an Overlord, 
however... something about today's race 
felt off to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They are not an opponent we can never 
beat. Firm in that conviction, Narita Top 
Road and Admire Vega had still not lost 
hope.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O is visibly shaken. Seeing 
this, Meisho Doto puts a certain idea into 
action—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, having carved out her own future, 
Narita Top Road advances to the first race 
of the Autumn GⅠ campaign—the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)!
